# Models produced by the 0.9.0 wheel

These six schema-2 bundles were generated by importing the actual 0.9.0 wheel,
before the layout and workflow changes. `producer.json` records the wheel hash
and runtime. Each bundle has its original sidecar and independent query/expected
arrays. Do not regenerate these fixtures using current package source.

The fixtures cover weighted independent POD and Gappy POD, uncentered SVD,
offset plus DCT, native Hodge components and calibrated conditional prediction.
Gappy queries include sample-specific missing observations. Python minor and
persisted numerical backend requirements are respected when testing them.
